title: Which jobs to clear first (priority order)
keywords: priority order which job first pending acceptance clear sgh tiktok shopee bakes telemedical
body: Clear Pending Acceptance in this order: SGH (never outsource, refer to Hamyzan) → TikTok → Shopee/Lazada → bakes and cooked food → telemedical → normal customers.
Priority order jobs (refer to Philip), 1-hr rush, 3-hr express and non-movables must never lapse or expire.
Check that 1-hr rush and 3-hr express jobs are picked up and delivered within the timeslot.
escalate: Priority order jobs → Philip. SGH → Hamyzan.
